objects.name: Analytic 1665
objects.description: For Android, detect Access Notifications from documented management, network, or vetting evidence; treat state queries as periodic observations rather than real-time events. Correlate Application Permission via Android Enterprise DPC / Application Vetting [DevicePolicyManager.getPermissionGrantState(); PackageManager manifest/requested-permission review]; Application State via Android Enterprise / EMM [Managed package inventory/status and package metadata]; OS API Execution via Application Vetting / Instrumented Dynamic Analysis [Dynamic API/runtime trace: App intercepts notification content from source_app IN $HighValueNotifApps$ (banking, auth, messaging) while AppState=background]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

x_mitre_mutable_elements.description: Approved notification management apps (Tasker-equivalent enterprise tools, approved wearable companions). Minimal. Derive from MDM catalog.
Banking, 2FA authenticator, enterprise email, SMS apps whose notification content contains OTPs or credentials. Derive from MDM app catalog by data-sensitivity tier.
Default 300s. Notification interception >5min after last user interaction with device locked = covert.
